name: Move Myntra data to Snowflake
steps:
1.  From the Data Sources section select Myntra as the data source.
2.  Select your added Snowflake data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Myntra account with your **Secret Key & Merchant Id.** Read more about how to find these details [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/myntra/setup.html).
4.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/myntra/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
